title: haworthia umbraticola var. obesa

It is known for its distinctive, rounded, and thickened leaves that store water, allowing the plant to thrive in dry conditions. The health benefits of Haworthia umbraticola var. obesa are still being researched, but it is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation.
